$comment: Single source of truth shared by Blender (blender/scripts), the web scene (src/scene/guide) and the validator (scripts/check-guide.mjs). Change names here, never in one place only.

asset.rootMotion: none: clips animate in place; the web scene owns the flight path

bones.$naming: Use _L / _R suffixes. three.js strips '.' from node names, so Blender's default '.L' would arrive as 'upperarmL' and break the contract.

morphs.$note: Shape keys on the face mesh(es). The web adds blinking on top of eyesClosed, so do not bake blinks into clips.
morphs.$moods: The Emblem Evolutions sheet maps to these: Zen Mode = eyesClosed; Happy High = grin + squint; Focused Flow = eyesClosed + browsUp(-); Sleepy Cloud = mouthOpen + eyesClosed; Chill Vibes = smile.

optional.third_eye: The turquoise third eye. The web scene raises its glow as he wakes (add an emissive strength > 0 so there is something to raise).
optional.gold_jewellery: Ear hoops and pendant. Kept shiny.

clips.name: seated_idle
clips.beat: Seated on a cloud, eyes closed, slow breathing.

clips.name: wake
clips.beat: Eyes slowly open; head lifts; shoulders settle.

clips.name: acknowledge
clips.beat: Turns to the camera, small smile and nod: he sees you.

clips.name: beckon
clips.beat: Raises right hand, palm up, fingers curl 'follow me'. Must loop cleanly.

clips.name: rise
clips.beat: Leans forward, unfolds legs, lifts off the cloud into a flying pose.

clips.name: fly
clips.beat: In-place flight cycle: body horizontal towards +Z, right arm leading, legs trailing.

optionalClips.name: perch_idle
optionalClips.beat: Seated on his cloud in the portfolio hero, awake and content, small shifts of weight. If missing, seated_idle plays with eyes held open.

optionalClips.name: land
optionalClips.beat: From flight back to seated on his cloud. If missing, rise plays in reverse.

optionalClips.name: stand_idle
optionalClips.beat: Standing beside a section, relaxed, breathing, small weight shifts. Feet on the ground at y = 0.

optionalClips.name: hover_idle
optionalClips.beat: Floating beside a section, legs dangling, gentle bob.

optionalClips.name: walk
optionalClips.beat: In-place walk cycle facing +Z. The site moves him; keep the root still.

gestures.name: point
gestures.beat: Right arm points ahead and to his right, head follows, then returns. The site turns his body towards the target.

gestures.name: wave
gestures.beat: Right hand raised beside the head, a friendly wave, then down.

gestures.name: react
gestures.beat: Happy surprise when clicked: arms up, little bounce, big grin.

gestures.name: emote_tap
gestures.beat: Digital Creations: taps the air with a finger, like a screen.

gestures.name: emote_tada
gestures.beat: Ventures & Brands: opens both arms wide, ta-da.

gestures.name: emote_groove
gestures.beat: Music & Sound: head bobs to a beat, eyes half closed, smile.

gestures.name: emote_read
gestures.beat: Books & Literature: hands open like a book, looks down, then up and smiles.

gestures.name: emote_paint
gestures.beat: Art & Experiments: sweeping brush strokes with the right hand.

$gestures: Gestures are UPPER BODY ONLY (spine, chest, neck, head, arms, hands; hips allowed for a bounce). Start and end each on the neutral idle pose. The site converts them to additive animation (relative to their first frame) and layers them over whichever idle is playing (sitting, standing or hovering), so one gesture works in every pose.
